title: Table 79. Document revision history
text_helper: Table 79. Document revision history — section 9 Revision history. Date, Revision, Changes.

rows: Updated number of SPI interfaces on cover page and in Table2: Ultra-low-power STM32L041x4/x6 device features and peripheral counts. Updated number of GPIOs for devices in UFQFPN28 in Table2: Ultra-low-power STM32L041x4/x6 device features and peripheral counts. Updated Section3.4.4: Boot modes. Updated Section3.16.2: Universal synchronous/asynchronous receiver transmitter (USART) and Section3.16.4: Serial peripheral interface (SPI) to mention the fact that USARTs with synchronous mode feature can be used as SPI master interfaces. Modified pin 2 in Figure6: STM32L041x6 UFQFPN32 pinout. Added Figure8: STM32L041G6UxS UFQFPN28 pinout. Table15: Pin definitions: – Added UFQFPN28 for STM32L041GxUxS part number. – Renamed PA0-WKUP-CK_IN into PA0-CK_IN – Renamed PA0-WKUP into PA0 Updated Table18: Current characteristics to add the total output current for STM32L031GxUxS. Added one power pair option in Table78: STM32L041x6 ordering information scheme.
